templates.pat: Thanks to funding from the {{1}} project, Expression Atlas contains {{2}} {{3}}, studying e.g. {{4}}, {{5}}, and {{6}}.
templates.zh: 本项目由{{1}}项目资助，Expression Atlas 收录 {{2}} 个{{3}}，研究物种如{{4}}、{{5}}和{{6}}。

templates.pat: The {{1}} experiments, are either RNA-seq or proteomics, and display expression levels of gene products under 'normal' conditions (e.g. normal rice tissues). Each experiment is manually curated to a high standard, and RNA expression levels are calculated using the {{2}} pipeline.
templates.zh: {{1}}实验或为 RNA-seq，或为蛋白质组学，展示基因产物在「正常」条件（如正常水稻组织）下的表达水平。每个实验都经人工严格整理，RNA 表达水平使用 {{2}} 流程计算。

templates.pat: The {{1}} experiments in Atlas, containing both microarray and RNA-seq data, allows users to query which genes are up-/down-regulatedin different experimental conditions, e.g. 'in Arabidopsis shoots, what genes are upregulated in plants treated by X?'
templates.zh: Atlas 中的{{1}}实验同时包含微阵列与 RNA-seq 数据，用户可查询在不同实验条件下哪些基因上调或下调，例如「在拟南芥地上部，经 X 处理的植株中哪些基因上调？」

templates.pat: You can download data for every dataset individually in Expression Atlas through our {{1}}.
templates.zh: 在 Expression Atlas 中，您可以经由我们的{{1}}逐个下载每个数据集。

templates.pat: You can also download multiple experiment files as a single ZIP archive using the command line with {{1}}.{{2}} For example:{{3}} {{4}} {{5}} Replace {{6}} and {{7}} with the experiment accessions you wish to download.
templates.zh: 您也可以使用命令行，通过 {{1}} 将多个实验文件下载为单个 ZIP 归档。{{2}} 例如：{{3}} {{4}} {{5}} 请将 {{6}} 和 {{7}} 替换为您要下载的实验登录号。
